name: Théodore Chassériau

summary.text: Théodore Chassériau was a Dominican-born French Romantic painter noted for his portraits, historical and religious paintings, allegorical murals, and Orientalist images inspired by his travels to Algeria.
summary.title: Théodore Chassériau

3564156: Venus Anadyomene is an oil painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1828. It depicts the classical scene of Venus Anadyomene, showing the Goddess Venus rising from the sea.
3918344: The Toilette of Esther or Esther Preparing to be Presented to King Ahasuerus, is an 1841 oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau.
4726754: Aline Chassériau is an 1835 oil-on-canvas painting by French romantic artist Théodore Chassériau, which represents Aline Chassériau (1822–1871), the painter's younger sister.
5971073: The Two Sisters is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French romantic artist Théodore Chassériau, created in 1843. Completed when the artist was twenty-three years of age, it depicts Chassériau's sisters Adèle and Aline.
7448167: Self-Portrait, or Portrait of the Artist in a Redingote, is an oil-on-canvas painting by French romantic artist Théodore Chassériau, painted in 1835 when the artist was 16. It is housed at the Musée du Louvre, in Paris.
12902282: Tepidarium is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1853. It is held in the Musée d'Orsay, in Paris.
17491031: Arab Chiefs Challenging each other to Single Combat under the Ramparts of a City (French: Chefs de tribus arabes se défiant au combat singulier, sous les remparts d'une ville) is an oil painting on canvas executed in 1852 by the French painter Théodore Chassériau.
Arab Chiefs Challenging each other to Single Combat under the Ramparts of a City
17493946: Macbeth and the Three Witches is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1855. It is inspired by a scene from William Shakespeare's 1623 tragedy Macbeth, when Macbeth, accompanied on horseback by Banquo, encounters the Three Witches on the moors.
18674570: Battle of Arab Horsemen Around a Standard is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, created in 1854. It is signed and dated by the painter.
Battle of Arab Horsemen Around a Standard
19801587: Andromeda Chained to the Rock by the Nereids is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1840.
Andromeda Chained to the Rock by the Nereids
27313254: Banquo's Ghost is an 1854 oil painting by the French Romantic artist Théodore Chassériau. The painting features a scene from William Shakespeare's tragedy Macbeth.
29298078: Christ in the Garden of Olives is an oil on canvas painting created in 1840 by French painter Théodore Chassériau. It was executed following a commission from the Ministry of the Interior.
Christ in the Garden of Olives (Chassériau)
29862982: Portrait of Prosper Marilhat is an 1835 portrait painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. It depicts his fellow painter Prosper Marilhat known for his Orientalist scenes.
29862996: Othello and Desdemona in Venice is an oil painting on panel by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1850. Inspired by William Shakespeare's 1604 tragedy Othello, it depicts Othello and his wife, Desdemona amongst the canals of Venice.
29863002: Susanna and the Elders is an oil painting on panel by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1856. Combining religious and nude art it depicts the biblical scene of Susanna and the Elders, a popular subject in European Art.
29863006: Portrait of Dominique Lacordaire is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1840. It is held at the Louvre, in Paris.
30728276: The Caliph of Constantine, full title, Ali Ben-Hamet, Caliph de Constantine and Chief of the Haractas, Followed by his Escort, is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. It is held at the Palace of Versailles.
61500830: The Defence of the Gauls by Vercingetorix is an 1855 history painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. It depicts the Battle of Gergovia, with the Gaulish warrior Vercingetorix leading his forces to victory over the Roman Empire.
The Defence of the Gauls by Vercingetorix
71828504: Portrait of Alexis de Tocqueville is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1850. It portrays the French politician and historian Alexis de Tocqueville.
115671751: Moorish Woman Leaving the Bath is an 1856 oil painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. Orientalist in tone, it combines element of genre painting and nude art.
137653332: Diana Surprised by Actaeon is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1840.
